w: Ningyōchō chicken house (1760) credited in one account with inventing oyakodon in the 1880s — lunch queues for the bowl, chicken sukiyaki at night.
Yotsuya-area neighbourhood sushi counter with a Michelin Bib Gourmand in the 2026 guide — rare good-value Edomae nigiri.

address: Kichijōji-Minamichō, at the entrance to Inokashira Park, Musashino, Tokyo
w: Smoky yakitori institution on this spot since 1928 — the last stop before Inokashira Park, with cheap skewers and beer for walkers and families.

address: Old Tōkaidō road near Hatajuku, Hakone, Kanagawa
w: Thatched teahouse on the Old Tōkaidō stone road, run by the same family for some 400 years — warm amazake and mochi for hikers between Hatajuku and Lake Ashi.

dish: nigiri ordered by the piece from a blackboard of sushi and snacks
w: Basement sushi counter in Kamiyamachō (Oku-Shibuya) where you order single pieces off the blackboard — a Michelin Bib Gourmand, so a counter-sushi meal without the omakase bill.

dish: clear chicken-based shōyu (soy-sauce) ramen with two kinds of pork and wontons
w: Ex-DJ chef Takuro Yanase's Meguro counter — a pure, clear chicken shōyu ramen loaded with two kinds of pork, wontons and fried onion. Michelin Bib Gourmand 2026.
Koishikawa unagi house near Kōrakuen — one of the Michelin Guide's picks for Tokyo's Edo-style freshwater eel, and a Bib Gourmand.
Small, old-school Asakusa eel shop a few steps from Kaminarimon — a Michelin Bib Gourmand and one of the guide's Tokyo unagi picks.
Basement eel restaurant just outside Mejiro Station — a Michelin Bib Gourmand and one of the guide's Tokyo unagi picks.

dish: Edo-style soba with large conger-eel (anago) tempura
w: Graceful old-school Ryōgoku soba house near the Edo-Tokyo Museum; the chef scours Japan for buckwheat, and the big anago tempura is a Michelin inspectors' favourite dish. Bib Gourmand 2026.
Shimbashi tempura counter for rice bowls and set meals — the signature kakiage-don of crisp shrimp fritters is a Michelin inspectors' iconic-Tokyo-dish pick. Bib Gourmand 2026.
Ningyōchō tonkatsu in a refurbished old house fitted out with recycled wood — loin and fillet set meals, à la carte or courses. Bib Gourmand 2026 and a Michelin inspectors' iconic-dish pick.

dish: hikarimono — silver-skinned fish nigiri (kohada gizzard shad, mackerel)
w: Drop-in, affordable sushi next to the National Art Center, named for and best at the shimmering blue-skinned fish — kohada and saba. A Michelin inspectors' iconic-Tokyo-dish pick.

dish: counter sukiyaki with egg whites whipped to a meringue
w: Kappo-style Toranomon counter where the server cooks alternating slices of beef and vegetables in front of you; the meringue-whipped egg dip is the twist. A Michelin inspectors' iconic-Tokyo-dish pick.

dish: seasonal kaiseki — e.g. spring shellfish clear soup (suimono) with gomadōfu
w: Chef Hidetoshi Nakamura's Nishi-Azabu kaiseki — Tokyo's newest three-star (MICHELIN Guide Tokyo 2026); the clam-and-gomadōfu clear soup was an inspectors' dish of the year.

dish: Edomae nigiri — incl. seasonal whole salt-grilled ayu (sweetfish) nigiri
w: Akasaka sushi counter whose whole salt-grilled sweetfish nigiri was one of the Michelin inspectors' 2026 dishes of the year.
Shiba sushi-ya whose thick, soft harakami tuna nigiri — the star topping of Edo sushi — was a Michelin inspectors' favourite dish of 2025.
Sasazuka stand-up sushi bar serving nigiri only — the Edo-era tachigui format, and a Michelin Bib Gourmand since the 2025 Tokyo guide.

dish: tonkatsu and yōshoku fry set meals
w: Takadanobaba basement fry shop — tonkatsu and yōshoku cutlets; new Michelin Bib Gourmand in the 2025 Tokyo guide.
Mita neighbourhood sushi counter that made the Michelin Bib Gourmand list in 2025 and kept it in 2026 — counter sushi at Bib prices.
Second-floor Japanese-cuisine counter in Yotsuya's Arakichō backstreets, added to the Michelin Guide in 2024.
